sources.claim: Original fictional plans. Equal tiles encode a fixed declared amount, not equal risk, productivity or benefit. Listed transfers reassign an unchanged total; no returns, spending, losses, fees, arrivals or optimization are modeled. Every token retains its identity and size. The source is debited on departure and the destination credited on arrival; parked plus in-transit tokens always equal the original total. The clock is editorial, not observed transfer duration. Final bars encode counts from zero on one shared scale, with approximate shares labeled.
